description.la: Vallis liliorum: triginta quattuor capitula de virtutibus, de patientia, humilitate, caritate et vita aeterna. Textus ex editione Pohl (1918), versio Anglica anni 1867.
description.en-US: The second garden book, in thirty-four chapters on the virtues the lily stands for: humility, patience, the tongue, the heart, union with God and the eternal praise of God, each chapter opening on a scripture verse. The Latin is Pohl's critical edition (Freiburg 1918), from a raw OCR of the printed volume; the English is the anonymous 1867 Baltimore translation.
description.pt-BR: O segundo livro-jardim de Tomás, em trinta e quatro capítulos sobre as virtudes simbolizadas pelo lírio: humildade, paciência, língua, coração, união com Deus e louvor eterno.

sources.edition: Thomae Hemerken a Kempis Vallis liliorum, ed. M. J. Pohl (Freiburg: Herder 1918), Opera omnia IV; archive.org raw OCR (Pohl 1918 volume).
sources.description: The thirty-four chapters of the Vallis liliorum. Line numbers, running heads and page breaks stripped by script; Pohl's critical footnotes and introduction are not imported. Chapter titles are Pohl's upper-case titles recased (u/v normalised by script). Raw OCR: drop capitals at chapter openings and isolated letters are often garbled.

sources.edition: The Little Garden of Roses and Valley of Lilies, anonymous English translation (Baltimore: Murphy 1867); archive.org OCR.
sources.description: The thirty-four chapters of the Vallis, matched chapter by chapter with the Latin. The English prints each chapter's Latin scripture motto and its translation. Raw OCR with residual slips.
